title: publish: a publish whose registry refused an object answers a distinct outcome naming it, not "published" (follow-up A of #33005)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czXwx6JtQPvacrzzUw

Follow-up of #33005, by the maintainer's ruling there (「D 先告警,A 后续跟上」). #33005 makes the refusal loud (an error log and a `published[].advisories` entry with a stable rule code). This card makes it honest for programmatic callers.

## Change

When the registry refuses one or more objects during `publishPackageDrafts`, the response names them and does not say `published`. Add a new outcome value to `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema` (working name `published_unregistered`, `success: false`), listing the unregistered objects and reusing #33005's rule code.

## Consumers to adapt in the same release

- Studio / Packages UI (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`, which switches on the outcome).
- The hosted cloud's AI build path, which must stop or retry before seeding.
- The app-visibility flip allow-list in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` needs a ruling for the new outcome.

Clause-② yes (spec enum change). Contract review owed. Area: E1 (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/**`) + spec.
